title: Honda e First Drive | Fully Charged
summary: Robert Llewellyn of Fully Charged takes an early, 19-minute test drive of the Honda e electric car in Frankfurt. He looks at its acceleration, camera wing mirrors and tight turning circle.
why: Shared in Honda e and camera-mirror threads as a look at the car's features and driving feel.

quote.text: I really like the Honda e. It looks good and has good features
